referenceFunction.generalComment: The multioutput-process "treatment PWB for further metallugical treatment" delivers the co-products "disposal, treatment of printed wiring boards” and "electronics scrap, for precious metal recovery, at preparation plant". The allocation is done 100% to the disposal process.; UUID: 8399296e-6131-4ceb-889e-7a6fb74cd3cc
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset represents the treatment of printed wiring boards (PWB) from electric and electronic devices for the recovery of precious metals in a metallurgical process. It includes infrastructure, energy consumption, and an estimation of the efforts for transportation. The process has no emissions to air / water.
